title: GTA6 Lets You Use Headphones for Radio and Podcasts
description: For the first time in the series, GTA6 allows players to listen to radio stations and podcasts on foot using connected headphones and smartphones.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## A New Era of Audio Immersion in GTA6: Headphones and Podcasts

As anticipation continues to build for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, new details regarding the gameplay experience of *Grand Theft Auto 6* have emerged. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, GTA6 will introduce a series-first feature that significantly enhances audio immersion while exploring the open world on foot.

### Listening to Radio Stations Outside of Vehicles

Throughout the history of the *GTA* franchise, the vehicle radio has been an iconic staple of the gameplay experience, providing a soundtrack to chaotic police chases and scenic highway drives alike. However, once players stepped out of their cars, the music would stop, leaving only the ambient sounds of the city.

Eurogamer reports that GTA6 will change this dynamic entirely. For the first time in the series, players will be able to listen to radio stations while not in a car. This is made possible by wearing headphones and earbuds connected to the in-game smartphones, allowing players to keep the music playing during on-foot exploration and activities.

### Introduction of On-Demand Podcasts

In addition to traditional radio stations, GTA6 is expanding its audio offerings by introducing on-demand podcasts. According to the report, players will be able to dive into various podcast programs—such as true crime content—while navigating the game world. This addition brings a fresh layer of modern satire and entertainment to the game, perfectly aligning with the franchise's signature tone.

### Editor's Take

Rockstar Games continues to set the benchmark for open-world immersion with thoughtful quality-of-life updates. Allowing players to use headphones for radio stations and podcasts on foot transforms the downtime in GTA6, making every walk through the city feel alive and deeply entertaining.
